references.text: The prophecy that God's suffering servant will bear the sins of 'many' (more than Israel), which foresees the gathering of the scattered nations.
The mission to be a light for the nations, so that salvation may reach 'to the ends of the earth', parallel with gathering the scattered.
The prophecy that the Lord will gather Judah and Israel, and bring them together from the lands where they are scattered, to make them one people.
Paul explains that Christ has made the two (Jews and Gentiles) into one, and has broken down the wall that separated them, to create one new humanity.
